description: This file manages fractional indexing for elements, including validation, ordering, and synchronization of fractional indices within a drawing or scene. It defines functions and classes related to maintaining and correcting element order based on fractional indices, supporting features like undo/redo and multiplayer reconciliation.

classes.name: InvalidFractionalIndexError
classes.description: Custom error class for invalid fractional index detection.

methods.name: validateFractionalIndices
methods.description: Checks if all elements have valid fractional indices, throws error or logs if invalid.

methods.name: orderByFractionalIndex
methods.description: Sorts elements based on fractional indices, breaking ties with element IDs.

methods.name: syncMovedIndices
methods.description: Synchronizes indices of moved elements with array order, falling back to default sync if invalid.

methods.name: syncInvalidIndices
methods.description: Corrects invalid fractional indices by mutating elements.

methods.name: syncInvalidIndicesImmutable
methods.description: Creates new instances of elements with corrected indices for invalid entries.
